## Fixed
- **Melon and pumpkin looked wrong in the planter.** They rendered as a washed-out gray *stem* (the bed draws crops untinted, and stem textures are grayscale). They now show the actual full-colour melon/pumpkin, swelling from small to full as it grows — accurate and far more readable.

## Changed
- **Melon now yields 3 slices per harvest** (down from 4 in v0.2.3). A trade-value tune: 3 keeps melon comfortably below pumpkin (the premium crop) while still fixing its old underpowered single-slice output — it lands above the grain staples and at par with a hand-built vanilla melon farm per plant.
